title: Studio worktree marker
description: Per-worktree manifest stamped at creation and heartbeat-touched on every owning-command turn. Consumed by scripts/studio-worktree-gc.sh and scripts/manager-cleanup.sh to decide which worktrees are safe to reap.

kind.description: Owning command class. ingest = manager ingest; plan = manager plan-chain; chain = chain runner / work-chain; worker = task-worktree-setup.

slug.description: Worktree directory basename. Stable id used by STUDIO_KEEP_WORKTREE and gc dry-run output.

project.description: Project slug the worktree belongs to (matches resolve_project for the main checkout).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the worktree was created. Set once; never updated.

last_touched.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last owning-command heartbeat. Updated on every manager turn or chain step.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier for ingest/plan kinds.

chain_id.description: Optional chain-run identifier for chain/worker kinds.

task_id.description: Optional task identifier for worker kind.

pid.description: Optional pid of the owning process at marker-write time. Informational only — gc decisions use timestamps and active-chain state, not liveness probes.
